notes.title: Full Demo Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey playtesters!

After long last, the full demo of Musgro Farm is now available from the main [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954590/Musgro_Farm/]Steam Page[/url]!

It really helps the Steam algorithm and visibility if you grab it and play it for a little while. If you could, it would be really helpful for you all to give it a shot over the next couple days!

Content is similar to the playtest - lots has been added over the past ~6 months, but the demo mirrors some of the most recent playtest builds.

If you'd like to continue your old playtest saves, the balance may be a bit off, but the saves are compatible. Once you've got the demo installed you can copy your playtest saves over by right clicking the Playtest in Steam -> Manage -> Browse local files -> opening the Musgro Farm_Data folder and copying the Saves folder... Then browse local files for the demo, open the corresponding Musgro Farm_Data folder, and pasting your Saves folder there.

If you have questions about the future of the playtest you can read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3002310/announcements/detail/4458094434636005669]previous announcement[/url]. If you have other questions, you can post them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3002310/discussions/]community forums[/url] or come ask in [url=https://discord.gg/AutVxXjPn4]Discord[/url].

As always, any feedback is always appreciated, and I'm really grateful for all of your help!

[i]- Metallibus[/i]

notes.title: Demo Releasing November 20th!
notes.notes:
Hey playtesters!

After a few months of playtesting, and multiple rounds of improvements, I'm excited to announce that the official demo for Musgro Farm will be releasing on [b]November 20th[/b]! (Next Wednesday!)

I'm extremely grateful to all of you for helping me along this journey and for all the feedback this community has provided - it has absolutely led to a much better version of the game, and has helped me get to where I feel confident about pushing this iteration of the game more publicly.

[b]Thank you to all of you for your time and contributions![/b]

That being said, this is still just the beginning - I still have a bunch more feedback I'd like to include, and many more plans for future systems and content to add to the game. I'm excited to continue that journey towards a full release, and some additions will be making their way into the demo as well.

[b]How you can help:[/b]
Both downloading and playing the demo will [i]greatly[/i] help with Steam visibility and popularity, so it'd help out if you could do so when the demo releases. Playtest saves [b]are[/b] compatible with the demo, so you can either pick up where you were or start fresh. As a fair warning, the content of the demo release and the latest playtest builds are almost the same.

If you have the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954590/Musgro_Farm/]main game[/url] wishlisted, you'll get an email when the demo goes live.

[b]Where does that leave the playtest?[/b]
As of now, I don't plan to keep continuously updating these builds - you're free to keep playing them, but my development focus will be on maintaining the demo, getting it ready for Next Fest, and working on the full release of the game. The demo builds will therefore be the most up to date, and you should probably move over there when it releases.

[b]Will the playtest be used ever in the future?[/b]
There will definitely be points in the future where I'm looking for more testers for features/builds before they go public. I very well [i]may[/i] push some builds to this track in the future to get some early testing, but I'm not entirely sure at this point - some tests will likely happen in other places as well. 

That being said, I'm happy to have all of you along for those future tests as well!

[b]How to participate in future testing:[/b]
For future testing opportunities, I'll be pinging the [b]Playtester[/b] role in the [url=https://discord.gg/AutVxXjPn4]Discord server[/url]. If you have already joined the server, you should automatically have the role.

If you hadn't joined yet, do so and DM me for the role. I'm Metallibus - marked as [b]Developer[/b] in purple the top of the member list.

Thanks again everyone, and see you soon!

notes.title: Graphics & Performance Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Performance[/h3]
A new version is now live which includes some substantial graphical performance updates. These changes should increase performance by about ~30-50% in most cases, with minimal impact on graphical fidelity. These updates tend to be even more impactful on larger farms, but should be helpful throughout the game.

In addition, there's also now some basic settings auto detection which should help pick an appropriate configuration based on your hardware. If you aren't satisfied after hitting "Auto", please tweak the settings as you'd prefer them, then hit [b]Send Feedback[/b] from the Esc menu to help me improve the auto detection.

[h3]Simple Vegetable Soup[/h3]
There's also a bit of a balance tweak, such that the final Soup recipe also requires Aromatic Vegetables as well, but produces fewer items for a higher value, thus increasing density.

notes.title: Recipe, Pipette, and Level QOL Updates!
notes.notes:
A new testing version is available which features a few QOL changes around recipe visibility/organization and pipetting buildings and fields. These changes are heavily influenced by feedback - thank you to everyone in the community, whether that's sending feedback in game or those of you chatting on [url=https://discord.com/invite/AutVxXjPn4]Discord[/url]!

[h2]Recipe Popout[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030405/78debbbffd15ce8c8b7a473ddc7bb5e96ff241cf.png[/img]
There's now a "pop out" button on recipes in the Almanac. This will show the recipe in a floating window so you can keep track of what you need to build.

[h2]Better Pipetting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030405/70c542e60def8f9719c12a8edc77543407a69ed5.gif[/img]
Added a bunch of functionality to the Pipette function (Q). Pressing Q over a field or building will put you in build mode for that field or building, and will now also copy the orientation and any selected recipe.

In addition, this functionality now also works on UI elements, such that pressing Q over a crop icon will put you in "build mode" for that field, and pressing Q over a recipe product icon qwill put you in "build mode" for the corresponding building with the recipe pre-selected.

This doubles up with the Recipe Popout, such that you can open a recipe in the Almanac, pop it out, then "Q" each of the ingredients to quickly build each field or building.

[h2]Level Indicators[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030405/79a39586ac2f363b15b83d6450773507647dba7b.png[/img]
There's now a new indicator mode for the plot balloons which displays Rank, Level, and Worker counts instead of storage. Press [i]Alt[/i] to switch between modes. This new mode is aimed to make it easier to see an overview of your layouts and which plots may be behind on upgrades, etc.

[h2]Truck Updates[/h2]
After investigating a couple bug reports, I found a few underlying issues with the way trucks were being dispatched. This version contains some pretty hefty updates to truck logic, so please report any new or remaining issues you see with either frozen or misbehaving trucks.


[h3][i]Note on bug reports[/i][/h3]
If you hit an intermittent issue, it is most helpful to report it when you see it by hitting [i]Esc -> Send Feedback[/i] as that will submit your game state / save so that I can directly reproduce the issue. Other feedback on how things do/should work or anything obvious is more than welcome anywhere - whether that's Discord, the Community Hub, etc.


[h3]Full Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Levels/Rank/Workers balloon to [i]Alt[/i] modes
[*] Added "Time to level" estimates when mousing over XP bars
[*] Large rework to truck reservation logic, fixing some issues when moving plots and reducing contention between trucks
[*] Make waste trucks respond to paused Compost Area
[*] Maintain plot rotation when pipetting
[*] Copy recipe when pipetting a building [i](Not sure if this is more annoying or helpful - let me know what you think!)[/i]
[*] Added pipetting of UI elements such as crops -> fields or recipes -> building
[*] Added button border blink to Contracts button when new contracts are available
[*] Maintain Plot Window tabs when you manually select one and then select a different plot
[*] Fixed tech tree spacing/edges cutting off some elements
[*] Fixed some issues with collection rule edits
[*] Prevented alt balloon logic from firing when alt tabbing, and some other alt tab behaviors
[*] Fixed a few issues with Save menu such as preventing changing names in list when typing
[/list]

notes.title: New Playtesting Content!
notes.notes:
A new playtesting update has just arrived, with large updates to balance and scaling, as well as new crops, recipes, and systems to explore! The updates focus on smoothing out the overall pacing and goals, adding more control over your logistics, and a bunch of quality of life changes.

[i]Saves from previous playtests [i]will[/i] still load, but due to the scope of changes, you'll likely run into balance issues due to the new money scaling, and you may have out-of-order techs. As such, it is recommended to start a new save.
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030405/6fbab6e02453fe9cc1e1f0739a106dad455ec5f1.png[/img]

[h2]Content & Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Business Tech Tree and basic contracts. Accept contracts for specific products, then collect and ship them for bonus XP or higher sale prices.
[*] Added Basic Logistics which will allow you more fine grained control over what vehicles pick up and from where.
[*] Added Soup Kitchen and Simple Vegetable Soup recipe, requiring a larger chain of ingredients than previous playtest recipes.
[*] Added more crops and recipes necessary for soup recipes.
[*] Massive money rebalance - both costs and sale values significantly lowered in scale to avoid overwhelmingly large numbers from appearing too soon and rapidly outscaling content.
[*] Lots of content pacing changes. "Early Game" should be much faster, and "Mid Game" a bit slower to avoid getting new techs faster than they can be used/understood. Things like final workers are more significant investments.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030405/ad427e7dde1b4ff09ae49116c27de27f5b5c3ed9.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Allow multi selecting fields. Ctrl click to add/remove from selection, shift + left mouse drag to select an area.
[*] Show total cost on upgrade buttons when holding ctrl/shift, and hovering over the button will show info about how many upgrades will be purchased.
[*] Destroying plots will now refund a portion of the investment value, shown when hovering over delete button.
[*] Added tech for "moving" plots, but costs a portion of the investment value.
[*] Full Storage buildings will now still allow neighbors to pass crops through them.
[*] Edge scrolling won't trigger when hovering buttons/controls near the edges of the screen.
[*] Added more Farmer's Guide content for advanced system explanations.
[*] Added "More Info" buttons to quest prompts that link to associated topics in Farmer's Guide for more info.
[/list]

[h2]Technical[/h2]
[list]
[*] Post processing improvements for a better and more colorful feel.
[*] Anti Aliasing and Flora Density settings
[*] Large changes to tree LODs to improve frame rates, will eventually be migrated to more content for more performance games.
[*] Large rework to control systems to allow better click targeting + control mapping. Includes allowing right alt/shift/ctrl and arrow keys as additional controls, but more features to follow up.
[*] Prevent copy/paste behavior overwriting and resetting recipes. Better refund logic for when recipes are changed.
[*] Fixed rotated building entrances not matching models. Will not affect previously constructed buildings.
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Connection Toggling Update!
notes.notes:
A new playtesting update has been published based on some community feedback and a few bugs:

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Connections:[/b] You can now disable individual connections between adjacent fields and buildings! Simply click on the arrows to toggle between different options. Many players were asking for more control over the distribution of products, and this will allow you to pick where certain fields or buildings pass their goods.
[*] Fixed some bugs with large clumps of neighbors, particularly with multiple storages, where goods wouldn't be moved properly and would get stuck.
[*] Fixed some small misleading vehicle behaviors
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

[h3]Planned upcoming changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Graphical performance improvements - some updates here likely in next build
[*] Better visibility of ranks/levels
[*] Truck AI improvements
[/list]

Have other thoughts? Feedback? Or want to share your opinion on what should come next? Hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/AutVxXjPn4]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: New Playtesting Version!
notes.notes:
A new playtesting update has been published based on a bunch of community feedback!

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Prevent Sale:[/b] You can now prevent the sale of items from specific fields or buildings! Simply click the "$" button on the info window and collection trucks will no longer pickup or sell items from that field or building. This can be used to reduce strain on your collection trucks.
[*] [b]Updated Camera Controls:[/b] Added edge scrolling, middle mouse panning, and settings for pan/zoom/rotation speeds.
[*] [b]Better Rank Up Progress:[/b] Shows current/needed compost in field info when the field is gathering compost for a rank up.
[/list]

[h3]Other tweaks and changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed misleading storage connection arrows.
[*] Added "help" button callouts in a couple places to explain some mechanics.
[*] Slight tweaks to some collection truck priorities.
[*] Added warning/confirmation when ranking up fields to a penalized crop.
[*] Small improvements for windowed mode regarding application focus.
[*] Small improvements to field/building placement accuracy.
[*] Other small UI tweaks and usability changes.
[*] A few bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Planned upcoming changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Graphical performance improvements
[*] Better visibility of ranks/levels
[*] Truck AI improvements
[/list]

Have other thoughts? Feedback? Or want to share your opinion on what should come next? Hop into the [url=https://discord.gg/AutVxXjPn4]Discord[/url]!
